entries.t: 上海交通大学倪俊开发的新型太阳能-化学混合驱动生物合成策略及其应用
entries.c: 零碳产业/物质循环/有机物（碳循环）/有机工业/生物过程/合成生物学
entries.as: 上海交大倪俊团队提出"太阳能-化学混合驱动生物合成"（SCHB）策略，将亚磷酸盐脱氢酶引入蓝藻，使其能从工业废水中提取亚磷酸盐。亚磷酸盐兼具替代磷源与额外电子供体双重功能（氧化还原电位-690mV），为还原性合成提供NADPH弥补光电子不足，有望突破光合生物合成中光限制和易污染两大瓶颈，将工业生产从石化依赖中解耦。
entries.cm: 生物合成有望将工业生产从石化依赖中解耦，预计2029年全球市场规模达512亿美元；传统异养细胞工厂虽是当前生物生产的主力，但其可持续性面临两大挑战：依赖糖基原料，与有限耕地竞争，加剧粮食安全与生物多样性压力；异养代谢伴随CO₂形式的碳损失，降低原子经济性。太阳能驱动的自养生物合成通过光能固定CO₂，消除糖原料负担，减少代谢碳损失。然而，该路线仍存在瓶颈：相互遮光导致光合电子受限，造成细胞密度低和辅因子再生效率低下——向光合生物提供额外电子源可缓解此问题；易受污染是大规模开放培养的主要障碍，通常非无菌光能自养系统在体积超过10升时便会迅速崩溃。引入亚磷酸盐氧化途径，使蓝细菌以废水中的亚磷酸盐作为电子供体，突破了高细胞密度下彼此遮光导致光合电子受限。覆盆子酮是覆盆子果香的主要来源，可被用于食品饮料、化妆品、个人护理品。2024年全球覆盆子酮的市场规模大约在1亿到5亿美元之间，总体市场不算大。不过这种引入电子供体源的思路或可用于合成其他物质的自养合成生物学过程。
entries.b:
生物合成有望将工业生产从石化依赖中解耦，预计2029年全球市场规模达512亿美元。传统异养细胞工厂虽是当前生物生产的主力，但其可持续性面临两大挑战：一是依赖糖基原料，与有限耕地竞争，加剧粮食安全与生物多样性压力；二是异养代谢伴随CO₂形式的碳氧化损失，损害原子经济性。太阳能驱动的生物合成通过光能固定CO₂，消除糖原料负担，减少代谢碳损失。然而，该路线仍存在关键瓶颈：相互遮光导致光合电子受限，造成细胞密度低和辅因子再生效率低下——向光合生物提供额外电子源可缓解此问题；此外，易受污染是大规模开放培养的主要障碍，通常非无菌光能自养系统在体积超过10升时便会迅速崩溃。
上海交通大学倪俊团队提出“太阳能–化学混合驱动生物合成”（SCHB）策略，将亚磷酸盐脱氢酶引入蓝藻，使其能从工业废水中提取亚磷酸盐（在自然界中，绝大多数微生物无法利用亚磷酸盐作为唯一磷源，只能利用正磷酸盐）。磷是所有生物必需元素，但团队并非仅仅为了补磷——亚磷酸盐兼具双重作用：作为替代磷源（节约稀缺磷矿、回收污染物），同时作为额外电子供体（氧化还原电位-690mV，为还原性合成反应提供还原力NADPH，弥补光电子不足）。这一设计还意外赋予抗污染能力：绝大多数杂菌无法利用亚磷酸盐，而工程蓝藻可以，因此在非灭菌介质中占据绝对竞争优势，从源头上排除了杂菌生长的可能性。
利用亚磷酸盐作为唯一磷源和筛选标记，团队构建了无需抗生素的工程菌。该菌可稳定储存3个月，重复使用20次后仍保持超70%活性。在覆盆子酮合成（需消耗电子）中，仅光照驱动产量为2.19mM；加入亚磷酸盐后升至6.74mM（提升113%）。随后，团队将亚磷酸盐脱氢酶的辅酶由NAD改造为蓝藻富集的NADP（产量升至8.82mM），再将脱氢酶与覆盆子酮合成酶通过柔性链接融合，使电子传递路径缩短，产量达9.64mM，总效率提升至单纯光驱动的305%。对于依赖氧气的靛蓝合成，光合作用原位产氧使效率提升115%，染料可直接用于织物染色。
抗污染能力在500升非无菌光生物反应器中验证：野生型蓝藻两天崩溃，而工程菌稳定生长五天无污染。因实际工业废水高盐抑制生长，团队独立引入耐盐基因（钠/氢逆向转运蛋白），成功用废水制备催化剂，合成覆盆子酮和ε-己内酯，产率分别达4.09和1.16毫摩尔/升/小时，同时去除70%以上铵盐，菌体生物质（含58%蛋白质）可作肥料，实现营养闭环。
技术经济分析计算覆盆子酮最低保本售价为每公斤70美元——该价格低于当前市场价（80–180美元），意味着企业可盈利且具有价格竞争力。生命周期评估显示，SCHB路线每公斤产品仅排放0.95公斤CO₂当量，比糖基路线（7.16公斤）降低87%。该研究同步实现污染物处理、资源回收与绿色化学品生产，为可持续生物制造开辟了实用路径。文章于2026年4月13日发表在Nature Sustainability。

entries.t: 通过靶向化学设计在P2型层状氧化物中实现零相变以实现零应变钠存储
entries.a: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能量存储/电化学储能/二次电池/钠电池
entries.as: P2型层状氧化物因其优异的钠离子动力学而主导钠离子电池正极材料领域，但长循环中不可逆的P2-O3相变导致容量快速衰减。该研究通过目标化学掺杂策略，在P2型层状氧化物中实现了零相变行为，从根本上抑制了深度脱钠时的结构重排。这一突破显著提升了材料的循环稳定性和倍率性能，为钠离子电池在高能量密度和长寿命储能应用中的工程化推进扫除了核心材料瓶颈。
kp: [材料]: P2型层状氧化物正极
[策略]: 阶段特异性化学设计
[目标]: 零相变零应变钠存储
entries.b: P2-type layered oxide cathodes dominate sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) due to exceptional sodium ion kinetics. However, longstanding phase transitions (e.g., P2-to-O2) not only compromise this inherent kinetic advantage but also cause severe stress strain undermining structural stability. Here, we propose a stage-specific chemical design that targetly addresses de-sodiated interlayer O2- repulsion, the structural origin of phase transitions in P2 cathodes. The designed Na0.67Ni0.05Fe0.05Ti0.05Cu0.2Mn0.65O2 (NFTCM) cathode shows a record Na-layer spacing (3.67 Å) with reduced negative charge on oxygen ions, maximally lowering O2--O2- repulsion during the entire desodiation process. As evidenced by in situ X-ray diffraction, the NFTCM cathode shows a true zero-phase-transition behavior with a record-low volume variation of 0.062% upon cycling. This stable, zero-strain Na ions storage behavior contributes to exceptional rate capability (121 mA h/g at 10C) and remarkably stable cycling, retaining 93.7% capacity after 600 cycles. Furthermore, operando neutron diffraction data indicate that the eliminated phase transition also enables a robust oxygen framework, a crucial factor in stabilizing the ion storage process of layered oxides.

entries.t: 耐波动的非贵金属双功能Ni-Co-B整体式电极用于工业级阴离子交换膜水电解
entries.a: RSC - Energy Environ. Sci. latest articles
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能量存储/化学能/氢基能源
entries.as: 该研究开发了非贵金属Ni-Co-B双功能整体式电极，用于工业规模阴离子交换膜水电解(AEM-WE)。AEM-WE是绿氢生产的关键技术，但在间歇可再生能源供电条件下面临催化剂稳定性挑战。Ni-Co-B整体式电极兼具析氢(HER)和析氧(OER)双功能催化活性，其三维多孔结构提供了高电化学活性面积和传质效率。研究表明该电极在波动工况下表现出优异的耐受性和长期稳定性，为降低绿氢生产成本和推动AEM-WE工业化部署提供了实用方案。
kp: 电极[AEM电解水]: 非贵金属Ni-Co-B整体式
[设计]: 消除基底-催化剂异质界面
[特性]: 双功能且抗功率波动
entries.b: To address the stability challenges faced by anion exchange membrane water electrolysis (AEM-WE) using intermittent renewable energy, a fluctuation-tolerant bifunctional nickel-cobalt-boron (a-NiCoB) monolithic electrode was successfully developed in this study. The unique homogeneous monolithic design of the electrode eliminates the traditional fragile substrate-catalyst heterogeneous interfaces, leading to remarkable stability against vigorous bubble impact at high current density over 4 A cm−2. Meanwhile, the synergy between Co-doping and in-situ surface reconstruction facilitates precise electronic structure modulation, effectively suppressing active Ni dissolution. Consequently, the a-NiCoB electrode exhibits superior catalytic activity and robust stability under fluctuating conditions in 1 M KOH electrolyte, delivering ultralow overpotentials at 100 mA cm−2 (HER (hydrogen evolution reaction): 72 mV; OER (oxygen evolution reaction): 254 mV) and its HER/OER performance remains undegraded after 350 h and 10500 intensive start-stop cycles at 1 A cm−2. AEM electrolyzer with a-NiCoB as both anode and cathode, requires only 1.82 V to reach 1000 mA cm−2 in 1 M KOH at 60 oC. Encouragingly, it can also sustain vigorous fluctuating load between 50-2000 mA cm−2 over 1,440 cycles and the accelerated startup/shutdown cycle with negligible decay. This work synergistically optimizes activity and durability through structural design and compositional regulation, offering a highly promising technological pathway for the scalable development of green hydrogen energy.

entries.t: 基于物理的模型在破纪录极端天气预报中优于AI方法
entries.a: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
entries.c: AI与智能科技/AI软件层/底座大模型/多模态模型
entries.as: 研究系统评估了AI天气预报模型在极端天气事件中的表现，发现基于物理方程的数值天气预报模型在破纪录极端事件预测方面仍优于AI模型。尽管AI模型在整体预报技巧上已超越传统数值模型，但在罕见极端情景下因训练数据不足而表现欠佳。该结果对AI气象预报的可靠性和局限性提出了重要警示。
kp: [结论]: 物理模型HRES极端事件预测优于AI
entries.b: Artificial intelligence (AI)-based models are revolutionizing weather forecasting and have surpassed leading numerical weather prediction systems on various benchmark tasks. However, their ability to extrapolate and reliably forecast unprecedented extreme events remains unclear. Here, we show that for record-breaking weather extremes, the physics-based numerical model High RESolution forecast (HRES) from the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts still consistently outperforms state-of-the-art AI models GraphCast, GraphCast operational, Pangu-Weather, Pangu-Weather operational, and Fuxi. We demonstrate that forecast errors in AI models are consistently larger for record-breaking heat, cold, and wind than in HRES across nearly all lead times. We further find that the examined AI models tend to underestimate both the frequency and intensity of record-breaking events, and they underpredict hot records and overestimate cold records with growing errors for larger record exceedance. Our findings underscore the current limitations of AI weather models in extrapolating beyond their training domain and in forecasting the potentially most impactful record-breaking weather events that are particularly frequent in a rapidly warming climate. Further rigorous verification and model development is needed before these models can be solely relied upon for high-stakes applications such as early warning systems and disaster management.

entries.t: 通过生成式人工智能设计迈向19种氨基酸字母的生命
entries.c: AI与智能科技/AI软件层/底座大模型/文本模型
entries.as: 研究利用生成式人工智能设计蛋白质，探索以19种氨基酸字母（少于所有已知生命必需的20种标准氨基酸）维持生命的可行性。所有已知生物均由至少20种标准氨基酸构成蛋白质，减少氨基酸种类可简化生物体遗传编码、降低细胞代谢负担，对合成生物学中构建精简人工生命体具有基础性意义。该研究通过AI驱动的蛋白质从头设计，验证了缩减氨基酸字母表下蛋白质折叠与功能的可实现性，为构建最小化基因组的人工细胞铺路。
kp: [合成生物学]: 19氨基酸字母表构建生命
entries.b: Because all known living organisms are made from at least 20 canonical amino acids, the feasibility of life using a more simplified alphabet remains unclear. In this work, we leveraged computational design and synthetic biology to explore building a cell from a 19-amino acid alphabet. Initial analyses suggested that isoleucine (Ile) may be dispensable, which we confirmed by directly replacing Ile residues in essential proteins in Escherichia coli. Critically, protein language models and structure-based models were necessary to redesign functional Ile-less proteins in most cases. We systematically replaced all 382 Ile residues from the ribosome and combined 21 redesigned subunits at a native genomic locus to produce a viable, evolutionarily stable cell. This work provides a roadmap to create the first 19-amino acid organism since early evolution.

entries.t: 一种用于传感与计算的对称性可重构光电二极管
entries.c: AI与智能科技/AI硬件层/芯片
entries.as: 该研究提出一种对称性可重构光电二极管，可在传感器层面直接进行光电流计算，有望突破智能边缘设备的严苛功耗限制。通过改变器件结构对称性，实现感知与计算功能的一体化融合，减少数据搬运开销，为低功耗传感计算平台提供新范式。
kp: [器件]: 对称性可重构光电二极管
[计算模式]: 传感器级光电流直接计算
entries.b: Direct photocurrent computation at the sensor level could be used to address the stringent power constraints of smart edge applications such as microrobots and wearable electronics. However, the lack of viable device models and scalable integration methodologies restricts the implementation of such direct photocurrent computation. Here we report a symmetry-reconfigurable photodiode for sensing and computing. This device is based on silver bismuth sulfide, which is patterned between two high-work-function electrodes to form symmetrical back-to-back Schottky junctions; voltage programming can be used to induce a reversible symmetry-to-asymmetry transition via a localized electrochemical reduction of silver ions, lowering the Schottky barrier on one side of the device. As a result, the device can generate non-volatile, bipolar weights for in-sensor direct photocurrent computation. It is also fully compatible with thin-film transistor read-out circuits. We show that the approach can be used for infrared transmissive imaging as well as eye image recognition and actuator control.

entries.t: 中国科学院大连化学物理研究所孙剑研究员提出基于亲水促进策略实现温和条件下合成气高效转化为轻质烯烃
entries.as: 中科院大连化物所孙剑团队提出亲水促进策略，将羟基磷灰石等羟基促进剂与Na₂CO₃改性Co₂MnO₄物理混合，诱导形成协同的Co-Mn复合氧化物和Co₂C活性相。在250-260℃、0.1MPa温和条件下，CO转化率达70-82%，轻烯烃选择性超60%，碳利用效率高达13%为目前最高值，100小时反应后转化率仍达68%，稳定性优异。
entries.cm: 费托合成本身是一项非常成熟的技术，不过传统费托合成产物的选择性受限，例如低碳烯烃（C₂-C₄）的选择性长期以来较低。本文在廉价催化剂及温和反应条件下，提高了低碳烯烃的选择性和反应活性。尽管本催化剂的碳利用效率（即合成气中最终转化为低碳烯烃的碳占比）已处于已报道成果的前列，但该数值仍偏低，仅为13%，这是因为体系中有40%的碳经水煤气变换反应转化为CO₂。同时相关参数低于包信和团队2023年发表于《Science》的金属氧化物-沸石（OXZEO）催化体系，其CO转化率85%和轻烯烃选择性83%。不过，后者所采用的含锗催化剂成本更高，反应条件也更为苛刻，包信和团队已于2020年通过企业合作完成了年产千吨级烯烃的工业性试验验证，而本文成果尚无实际生产相关报道。
entries.b:
轻烯烃（乙烯、丙烯、丁烯，C2–C4）是化工产业的核心基础原料，传统上依赖石油烃类的热裂解或催化裂解生产。直接将合成气（CO和H2）在温和条件下转化为轻烯烃具有显著吸引力，
中国科学院大连化学物理研究所孙剑研究员将羟基促进剂（如羟基磷灰石Ca5(PO4)3(OH)、气相二氧化硅SiO2(F)或勃姆石AlO(OH)）与Na2CO3改性的Co2MnO4前体物理混合，在还原与反应过程中诱导形成协同的斜晶系Co–Mn复合氧化物和Co2C活性相。与以往疏水聚合物改性不同，该亲水策略保留了催化剂的亲水特性，通过界面羟基稳定低对称氧化物相，显著提升了CO活化能力。
在250–260℃、0.1 MPa、H2/CO比1–2的温和条件下，优化后的催化剂（以NCM-HAP15为例）实现CO转化率70–82%，轻烯烃选择性超过60%，轻烯烃碳利用效率高达13%，为目前报道的最高值。即使在较低H2/CO比（0.8–1）下，仍保持约60%–64%转化率和60%左右选择性，CO2选择性未显著升高，展现出优异的合成气利用效率和稳定性（100小时反应后转化率仍达68%）。
结构与机理研究（XRD、中子衍射、原位TEM、XAFS、DRIFTS及DFT计算）表明，羟基促进剂抑制了Co–Mn氧化物过度还原为Co0和深度碳化，诱导形成斜晶系Co–Mn氧化物作为主要活性相，促进吸附氢（H）辅助的CO解离生成CHx/CHxO中间体；而Co2C或Co2C–氧化物界面则负责这些中间体的C–C偶联，生成轻烯烃。原位谱学证实了醛类等H辅助路径的关键中间体，同时抑制了过氢化副反应。文章于2026年4月1日发表在Nature。

entries.t: 基于纳米线的AFM-IR显微技术：利用银纳米线功能化AFM探针揭示亚10纳米分辨率的化学结构
entries.a: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
entries.c: 通用技术/检测和表征/先进科学仪器
entries.as: 该研究开发了基于银纳米线功能化原子力显微镜(AFM)探针的纳米红外(AFM-IR)显微技术，实现了亚10纳米分辨率的化学结构成像。传统AFM-IR的分辨率受限于探针尖端尺寸和光热膨胀的空间扩展。银纳米线探针通过局域表面等离激元增强效应将红外光场压缩至纳米尺度，显著提升了空间分辨率和检测灵敏度。该技术在聚合物表征、生物组织纳米化学成像等领域具有广阔应用前景。
kp: 探针[AFM-IR]: 银纳米线功能化
entries.b: Atomic force microscopy-based infrared (AFM-IR) microscopy has emerged as a powerful tool for nanoscale chemical imaging, combining the topographical precision of AFM with the molecular specificity of IR spectroscopy. However, its performance is still limited by conventional metal-coated AFM probes, which provide only modest near-field enhancement, ultimately restricting both spatial resolution and chemical sensitivity. In this work, we present a nanowire-based AFM-IR approach that overcomes these limitations by introducing a probe design: Chemically synthesized noble metal nanowires are affixed to the tip of a standard AFM cantilever. These nanowires support Fabry-Pérot resonances, functioning as mid-IR antennas that generate strongly confined optical near-field, thereby enhancing spatial resolution and sensitivity. The probe design also enables stable AFM-IR operation on both hard and soft materials. We demonstrate significantly improved imaging and spectroscopic performance, achieving spatial resolution below 10 nm and sensitivity at the submonolayer level. These findings establish nanowire-based AFM-IR microscopy as a highly promising platform for superresolution vibrational spectroscopy, with broad applications ranging from soft matter and two-dimensional materials to biomolecular analysis.

entries.t: 一种非对称面外有序MAX相作为Janus MXene前驱体
entries.c: 通用技术/材料工程/其它先进材料
entries.as: 研究者合成了一种面外方向非对称有序的MAX相前驱体，进而制备出具有Janus结构（上下表面化学组成不同）的MXene二维材料。Janus MXene因镜像不对称性而表现出Rashba自旋轨道耦合、面内压电性等独特物性，在自旋电子学、催化和能量存储等领域前景广阔。该工作为可控合成非对称二维材料提供了新策略。
kp: [前驱体]: 面外非对称有序MAX相
[现状]: 实验合成尚未实现
entries.b: Janus 2D materials, characterized by their mirror plane asymmetry, exhibit exceptional properties such as the Rashba effect, piezoelectricity, and photocatalysis, making them valuable in electronics, spintronics, and energy applications. While theoretical designs predict high thermoelectric and photocatalytic performance for Janus MXene, experimental synthesis remains unachieved due to challenges in fabricating symmetry-breaking MAX phase precursors. Existing MAX phases with in-plane or out-of-plane ordering retain inversion symmetry, making them unsuitable for Janus MXene synthesis. In this study, we report a class of chemically ordered MAX phase, (Ti3/11Zr2/11Hf3/11Ta3/11)3(Al2/3Sn1/3)C2, as a candidate precursor for Janus MXenes. We experimentally verified its unique asymmetric ordering through structural characterization. Further atomic-scale analysis via X-ray total scattering and reverse Monte Carlo (RMC) modeling reveals intricate chemical ordering and their possible correlation with atomic displacements. This work provides a pathway for synthesizing Janus MXenes and highlights the structural requirements for achieving symmetry-breaking in MAX phases.
